item.title: DARING FOODS INC: Made From Plants; Daring; Plant Steak Bites; Ready in 4 Mins Microwaveable Pouch; Recall
item.product: Made From Plants; Daring; Plant Steak Bites; Ready in 4 Mins Microwaveable Pouch;
item.summary: defective packaging; packaging can rupture/explode during cooking. Product details: Made From Plants; Daring; Plant Steak Bites; Ready in 4 Mins Microwaveable Pouch; UPC: 86001124319
item.affectedPeople: Product was distributed to a single retail grocery chain customer with multiple locations in Florida and one location in North Carolina. A total of 6 locations received recalled product.
item.remedy: Affected quantity: 4544 cases / 27,324 individual retail units
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
